title: UOR Framework state namespace (Context, Binding, Frame, Transition)
unpinned: the Prism's transition records are W3C PROV documents that name each state by its u:digest address; they are not yet state:Context and state:Transition individuals. The namespace's SHACL shapes (UOR-Foundation/UOR-Framework at 562fd0d9576c0183c558b0fc7953ba9cd5a63691, conformance/shapes/uor-shapes.ttl) require on every Transition a certified trace:ComputationTrace and a morphism:TopologicalDelta, and on every Context its Witt length, capacity and grounding observables, which need the UOR kernel observables in the Prism first; the shapes then need pinning with a SHACL extractor before they are requirements here
